title: Fersya Shop
description: Modern storefront with Filament admin dashboard, granular RBAC, and inventory management.

caseStudy.tagline: Modern storefront with Filament admin dashboard, granular RBAC, and inventory management.

problem.headline: Streamlining organic retail commerce with automated stock management and staff permissions.
problem.description: Small businesses often struggle with managing offline and online stock counts. Fersya Shop provides a unified back-office with role-based staff access.

architecture.headline: Modular Laravel architecture with reactive Filament tables and automated audit trails.
architecture.description: Designed database schemas with foreign key constraints and transactional order placement to guarantee inventory integrity.

highlights.title: Granular Role-Based Access
highlights.detail: Multi-guard authentication separating store managers, fulfillment staff, and customers.

highlights.title: Stock Ledger Logging
highlights.detail: Immutable inventory change logs tracking stock additions, sales, and expirations.

features.title: Filament 3 Back-Office
features.description: High-speed administrative panel for product curation and order fulfillment.

features.title: Responsive Customer Storefront
features.description: Clean organic-themed shopping experience with fast category filtering.

takeaways: Using mature ecosystem tools like Filament drastically accelerates back-office delivery while preserving enterprise security.
